name: smog-saathi-ai
description: Smog Saathi AI — Explainable air pollution decision-support platform for families and communities

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,ML,WEB -c cyan,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm run dev:ml" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
